scope.authorization: Geometry-only dataset design, protocol revision, read-only authority audit, and documentation; no HF/training authorization.

authority.domain: Ordered D1..D6; 100-230 nm inclusive, 5 nm grid, 27^6=387420489; recovered closed candidate envelope, not open-ended production authority.
authority.numeric_constraints: Periodic cyclic gap >=60 nm including D6-D1; half-cell margin >=30 nm. Every point in this grid satisfies both; independent manufacturing authority unresolved.
authority.science: GaN + fixed MDC P1_ZL1_ALTERNATIVE_G3_A3 + 237 nm spacer + ordered K6, 500 nm pillars, 290 nm pitch, 1740x290 nm period, air; +z normal X incidence; native M1; 440-460 nm/1 nm; x/y periodic, z PML. Predict full C_hat m=-3..+3,n=0 TE/TM Cartesian and independent positive P_scale through frozen H2 and original H1; no order sorting/permutation.

quotas.one_face: 3 points for each of 12 lower/upper coordinate faces

boundary.projections: Report per each of 15 ordered-coordinate pairs unique exact cells /729 and occupancy of 3x3 coarse low/mid/high bins. Do not infer coverage from nearest-neighbor distance alone.

sampler.method: Scrambled Sobol discrete 27^6 candidates plus maximin within preregistered strata; ties choose earliest Sobol row.
sampler.confirmation_core: 17 interior+8 single-face+2 two-face=27; 10/27=37.04% exact-face, close to 36.98% uniform expectation.
sampler.stress: One three-face intersection is flagged and reported separately; do not interpret it as domain-average evidence.
sampler.response_blind: No truth, response, model error, routing, power, or prediction enters selection.

pointset.authority: New global vectors are proposal-only, outside source pool48, unenrolled, not Runner-approved, and have no canonical FSP.

models.input: Six ordered D coordinates; train-only mean/std. No wavelength/node/patch random rows, NP feature, or OOD input.
models.target: One 609-real-output spectrum per geometry: 588 Cartesian C_hat values (21x7x2) plus 21 log(P_scale); all 21 wavelengths remain grouped.
models.pscale: Require finite positive truth; train-only log statistics; inverse by exp, no epsilon/clipping. Nonpositive labels or nonfinite/overflow/underflow predictions are failures.
models.loss: Train-only C channel mean/shared residual RMS and log(P_scale) mean/std; equal-weight normalized C-state MSE + log(P_scale) MSE.
models.krr: RBF gamma {1/6,1/3,2/3} x ridge {1e-4,1e-2,1}; 9 settings; deterministic.
models.mlp: 6->32 GELU->32 GELU; separate 32->588 C_hat and 32->21 log(P_scale) heads; 21377 trainable parameters including both heads; AdamW lr=1e-3, wd {1e-5,1e-4,1e-3}, seeds {0,1,2}, max 1000 full-geometry updates, inner patience50/min_delta1e-5.
models.selection: Both model families retained. Hyperparameter selection only in 3-fold geometry-grouped inner CV of each outer-train pool; no outer-validation/confirm truth.

validation.outer: Four folds over new128 development only; each holds 32 groups (3 local axial+29 global). Old32 is train-only. All wavelengths stay with geometry.
validation.curve: Same fixed outer validation. Nested geometry-only train subsets. Size64 adds 3 local axial+29 global; size128 uses all 96 new outer-train groups. Inner-selected configuration is fixed across sizes. Across folds every new development group is held out once and used in training in other folds.
validation.final: Refit final candidates on all 160 development groups before confirm prediction freeze.

fits.explanation: V1's 284 count covered global model fits but not 13 local fits. V2 uses curve sizes 32/64/128 (omits total-size96), preserving inner search and final models and including all 13 local fits within 281 total; 3 fits remain unused. Each global fit predicts both C_hat and P_scale; no separate P_scale-only fits. Proposal only.

local.model: Full Cartesian C_hat plus independently predicted positive P_scale local affine model.
local.evaluation: 12 leave-one-axial-out fits; recompute all response-dependent preprocessing/sensitivity per fold using only training responses; freeze final fit/predictions before opening the four combinations.

confirmation.global: Save/hash both final candidate families, all MLP seeds/complex seed mean, preprocessing, configs, evaluator, and predictions for all 28 before generating/opening responses. One reveal/evaluation; report both, all 28 and strata core27/stress1.
confirmation.local: Four exact retained combinations confirm only local affine behavior.
confirmation.outcome: Apply every original conjunctive H1 gate unchanged. If one satisfies all applicable gates, report numeric attainment only; no production admission. If neither/both, report both. KRR seed-stability N/A is not a pass. No post-reveal model/threshold changes.
confirmation.conversion: If responses are later reused for development, document conversion and create a new sealed confirmation set.

h1.pscale: Report predicted P_scale diagnostics; original H1 has no standalone P_scale numeric gate. Do not add one.
